The final day of TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 has arrived, and the week is ending on a high note. As 10,000+ founders, investors, and technology leaders gather at San Francisco’s Moscone West, Day 3 features some of the conference’s most practical and future-focused discussions.
Explore sessions covering the next wave of AI innovation, startup growth strategies, fundraising, emerging technologies, and lessons from the entrepreneurs and investors defining the future of tech. Add in Startup Battlefield excitement, peer networking, and countless opportunities for serendipitous connections, and it’s one final opportunity to maximize your Disrupt experience.
Don’t miss your chance to be part of the conversations everyone will be talking about after Disrupt. Grab your pass now at 75% off the original ticket price and join us for Day 3.
Day 3 highlights
Registration hours: 8:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.
Stop by the registration desk in the Level 1 lobby of Moscone West to register in person or pick up your scannable event badge. The badge features Klik technology, which makes it easy to exchange contact information with people you scan your badge with. Using the event app, you can access and keep those contacts even after the event ends.
Expo Hall: 8:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.
Explore 320+ exhibiting startups showcasing cutting-edge technologies across industries. This is the center of Disrupt, where 10,000+ attendees converge to discover new breakthroughs and spark new connections.
Haven’t registered yet? You still can — but don’t wait, or you will miss out. Grab your ticket now and walk straight into the action: six industry stages, interactive roundtables, Q&A breakouts, hundreds of exhibiting startups, investor-founder meetings, AI-powered matchmaking networking, and side events lighting up the Bay Area tech scene all week long.
Pitch Showcase Stage
Make your way to the Pitch Showcase Stage at the back of the Expo Hall to experience one of the most electrifying formats on the conference floor: rapid-fire, one-minute lightning pitches from some of the most promising startups representing their home countries and regions.
